meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION + CALCULATION (Rev H active nose, model H1; nothing measured)

architecture_note: B = a skid ring on the FIXED front sleeve carries the writing force; the refill carrier (the moving nose) tilts on a 2-axis flexure gimbal so the ball moves up to +/-3 mm; the refill slides axially on a soft constant-force spring so the ball stays on the paper. Chosen over A (rigid nose carrying the load) by simulation: A's ceiling with perfect knowledge is 0.15-0.77 of the ink error against 0.09-0.24 for B, A needs 0.41 W of copper loss with a bias spring (1.9 W without) against about 0.004 W for B, and a rigid nose must press the tip into the paper for tilt-plane corrections (0.38 N rms writing-force change).

results_summary.note: ranges are means over test seeds per condition; B over 0.1-2 mm, 4-12 Hz and the three splits, A at r_rot 0.5 and 0.3-2 mm
results_summary.label: SIM (model H1, test seeds 200-203, first use; see results/opt/inertial_opt.json)

tip_travel_mm.label: PROPOSED; SIM: never at its limit with perfect knowledge of 2 mm tremor except peaks at 10-12 Hz (see sweep)

refill_axial_slide_mm.note: delta cot(theta) for the tilt-plane correction (2.5 mm at 3 mm, 50 deg) plus the tilt-dependent ball protrusion 1.1-7.3 mm at 75-35 deg (skid contact radius 5.5 mm); constant-force spring 0.15 N (P0 value, ASSUMPTION)
refill_axial_slide_mm.label: CALC

moving_mass_at_tip_g.label: CALC (parts in opt/inertial/revh.nose_parts: Ti carrier, D1 refill, Al arm, 4 NdFeB magnets)

actuator.type: 2-axis moving-magnet flat voice coils: 4 NdFeB magnets on the nose's rear arm, 4 flat coils with a soft-iron back ring in the handle; each magnet moves parallel to its coil (shear) for its own axis
actuator.drivers: 2 x TI DRV8214 H-bridge with current mirror (AMF-37), 3.7 V cell
actuator.label: CALC (adjoint design model opt/inertial/adjoint.py; magnet and copper data MFR AMF-28/AMF-29; leakage, fill and end-turn factors ASSUMPTION); peak = Km sqrt(3.7 V x 1.5 A), continuous = Km sqrt(0.35 W) per axis (ASSUMPTION thermal)

static_tip_load_N.bias: a fixed spring or magnet offset cancels the 0.126 N refill-spring component (constant in the handle frame when the grip sleeve fixes the roll)
static_tip_load_N.label: CALC (F_c 0.15 N, mu_ball 0.15, 50 deg; ASSUMPTION values from config/pencil.yaml)

servo.type: PID position loop on the 3-D Hall reading of the arm magnet; reference = -(tracker estimate) mapped to the tip
servo.label: ASSUMPTION (modelled in H1 as the stage's 2nd-order follower); sensitivity in the sweep

latency_ms.label: ASSUMPTION built on MFR OPT-37 (fusion) and CALC for the 2nd-order servo

power_model.formula: P_total = 0.065 + 0.012 + (F_tip_rms_t1^2 + F_tip_rms_t2^2) / Km_tip^2   [W]; F_tip = m_eff q'' + k_s q + ball loads - bias
power_model.label: CALC on SIM forces; 0.065 W base electronics and 0.012 W drivers/Hall ASSUMPTION

skid_ring.note: C-shaped heel skid (open at the front for visibility) - feel and visibility ASSUMPTION, to test (EXP-H03 extension)

mass_g.label: CALC from assumed parts +10 % wiring; board magnet option = D42-N52 0.75 g + keel 0.3 g (ASSUMPTION) +10 %

inertial_addon.as: not included in Rev H by the rule below; kept as an evaluated option (CAD variant, optional components in layout.json)
inertial_addon.module: Rear-cap reaction mass: WHA 19.8 g (d 10 x 14.0 mm), +/-2.8 mm, 2 axes, Km 0.9 N/sqrt(W)

power_W.note: copper loss max over all test conditions + 0.012 W driver/Hall (ASSUMPTION)

criteria.rule:
as used here (set after the grid, not pre-declared): >= 10 % further reduction of the ink error in the
    8-12 Hz, 1-2 mm band on every test seed at r_rot 0.5 and 0.7, and no split where it is worse on average.

inertial_addon.label: SIM + CALC

tracker.note: Rev H setting chosen by ParEGO on training seeds by a pre-declared false-correction rule; changed from the shipped set: g 2 -> 2.44, f_gate 5.88 -> 3, f_gate_w 2.1 -> 4, a_lo 2.36e-05 -> 3.21e-05, a_hi 0.000133 -> 0.000115, cap_k 2.43 -> 5.7, v_slow 0.0153 -> 0.028, harm 0 -> 0.883, lp_hz 36.2 -> 64.1, wmax_hz 14.2 -> 14.7

per_user_band.how: 20-30 s calibration at first use sets f_cal; the frequency search is limited to the band (opt/inertial/run_study.calibrated_params)
per_user_band.label: SIM (test seeds, +10 % calibration error)
